description: This Java class, PersistableCustomerOptionValuePopulator, handles the conversion from a PersistableCustomerOptionValue to a CustomerOptionValue in a shopping cart or product configuration context. It populates the CustomerOptionValue object with data from the persistable source, setting codes, descriptions, and related language data.

classes.name: PersistableCustomerOptionValuePopulator
classes.description: A class that extends AbstractDataPopulator to convert PersistableCustomerOptionValue objects into CustomerOptionValue objects, including setting descriptions in different languages.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Converts a PersistableCustomerOptionValue into a CustomerOptionValue, setting code, merchant store, sort order, and descriptions with language-specific data.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Returns null; not used in this implementation.

methods.name: setLanguageService
methods.description: Setter for injecting the LanguageService dependency.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Getter for accessing the injected LanguageService.
